sources.ref: NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics, Ch 3 Mango Treat (textbook pp.18-32), as read in the official NCERT CIET audiobook of the textbook

notes: Images generated with Agnes AI through the visual-director presets, reviewed against the checklist and content-qa. Provenance (prompts, hashes, rounds) is in tools/content-research/media/agnes-log.json. Delivered as WebP (3:2 at 1536x1024, 1:1 at 1024x1024); originals kept outside the repo. These images are for under-10s, so they stay generated until a person approves them (visual-director). Tiles are delivered on their pale tint background; they were not cut out. Narration and song audio stay requested until a voice is chosen (TRD D3), and the stroke-order guides need the Rive editor.

requests.brief: A cheerful, steady counting chant in English for class 1, spoken rhythmically with a pause after each number so children can clap and show fingers. Lyrics exactly as the transcript.

transcript.en: Plop! A mango on the ground, One little squirrel, look what she found! One! One more comes, a myna. Two! One more comes, a parrot. Three! One more comes, a sparrow. Four! One more comes, a crow. Five! One more comes, a pigeon. Six! One more comes, a koel. Seven! One more comes, a kingfisher. Eight! One more comes, a peacock. Nine! Count with me and clap with me: One, two, three, four, five, Six, seven, eight and nine! Nine good friends, and mangoes fine!

requests.brief: A cheerful, steady counting chant in Hindi for class 1, spoken rhythmically with a pause after each number so children can clap and show fingers. Lyrics exactly as the transcript.

transcript.hi: टप! गिरा एक आम रसीला, एक गिलहरी ने उसे पाया। एक! एक और आई, मैना। दो! एक और आया, तोता। तीन! एक और आई, गौरैया। चार! एक और आया, कौआ। पाँच! एक और आया, कबूतर। छह! एक और आई, कोयल। सात! एक और आया, किलकिला। आठ! एक और आया, मोर। नौ! गिनो मेरे साथ, ताली बजाओ: एक, दो, तीन, चार, पाँच, छह, सात, आठ और नौ! नौ दोस्त और मीठे आम!

requests.brief: Stroke-order guide for the numeral 1: a dot moves over the app's own font outline of 1 in the order taught in NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics, Ch 3 Mango Treat: a diagonal line, then from its right end a vertical line, then a horizontal line at the end of the vertical line (p.25). No drawn glyph in the file (anim-maker).

transcript.en: Start with a small slanting line, go straight down, then draw a line along the bottom.
transcript.hi: पहले छोटी तिरछी रेखा, फिर सीधे नीचे, फिर नीचे एक लेटी रेखा।

requests.brief: Stroke-order guide for the numeral 3: a dot moves over the app's own font outline of 3 in the order taught in NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics, Ch 3 Mango Treat: a letter c facing left, and from its end another letter c facing left (p.25). No drawn glyph in the file (anim-maker).

transcript.en: Make two little curves, one on top of the other, both open to the left.
transcript.hi: दो छोटे घुमाव बनाओ, एक के ऊपर एक, दोनों बाईं ओर खुले।

requests.brief: Stroke-order guide for the numeral 4: a dot moves over the app's own font outline of 4 in the order taught in NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics, Ch 3 Mango Treat: a vertical line, from its end a horizontal line, then a vertical line that crosses the horizontal line (p.26). No drawn glyph in the file (anim-maker).

transcript.en: Go straight down, then across, then draw a line down through it.
transcript.hi: सीधे नीचे, फिर आड़ी रेखा, फिर उसे काटती हुई नीचे की रेखा।

requests.brief: Stroke-order guide for the numeral 6: a dot moves over the app's own font outline of 6 in the order taught in NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics, Ch 3 Mango Treat: a capital C, then its end joined back to the C to make a circle (p.26). No drawn glyph in the file (anim-maker).

transcript.en: Draw a big curve like the letter C, then join its end round into a circle.
transcript.hi: अंग्रेज़ी के C जैसा बड़ा घुमाव बनाओ, फिर उसके सिरे को घुमाकर गोला बना दो।

requests.brief: Stroke-order guide for the numeral 7: a dot moves over the app's own font outline of 7 in the order taught in NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics, Ch 3 Mango Treat: a horizontal line, then a diagonal line from its right end (p.27). No drawn glyph in the file (anim-maker).

transcript.en: Draw a line across the top, then a slanting line down from its right end.
transcript.hi: ऊपर आड़ी रेखा, फिर उसके दाएँ सिरे से नीचे तिरछी रेखा।

transcript.en: Draw a circle, then a straight line down on its right side.
